Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini scored a goal on two shots, dished an assist, added two PIM and went plus-2 in Wednesday's 3-2 shootout loss to the Penguins.
Celebrini recorded three assists, including one on the power play, and six shots on goal in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Stars.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard scored a goal in a 1-0 win over Toronto on Saturday.
Bouchard scored an even-strength goal on two shots and added a power-play assist in Wednesday's 3-2 overtime win over the Flyers.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider had two assists, two shots on goal and two blocked shots in Thursday's 5-4 loss to the Panthers.
Seider scored a goal on six shots and added three hits in Tuesday's 3-2 loss to the Blues.

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes scored an empty-net goal on three shots in Thursday's 5-2 win over the Capitals.
Hughes notched two assists, including one on the power play, and fired three shots on net in Sunday's 4-0 win over the Maple Leafs.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier scored a goal on three shots in Saturday's 6-2 loss to the Islanders.
Gauthier scored a goal on seven shots and added two hits in Wednesday's 4-2 loss to the Predators.

Dylan Guenther.summary: Guenther (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Wednesday and is expected to miss 2-4 weeks.
Guenther (undisclosed) is questionable for Wednesday's matchup against Vegas, per Brogan Houston of the Deseret News.
Dylan Guenther.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Brogan Houston (Deseret News.)

Jakob Chychrun.summary: Chychrun tallied a power-play goal, picked up an assist and launched five shots on net in Tuesday's 6-5 loss to Dallas.
Chychrun notched two assists, four shots on goal and five blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 overtime win over the Sabres.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored a goal on three shots in Saturday's 4-3 win over the Panthers.
Tuch scored a goal, added two hits and blocked two shots in Thursday's 4-3 win over the Predators.

Jeremy Swayman.summary: Swayman turned aside 19 of 24 shots in Saturday's 6-2 loss to Minnesota, with the Wild's final goal getting scored into an empty net.
Swayman will patrol the home crease against Minnesota on Saturday, per Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now.
Jeremy Swayman.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Jack Studley (Boston Hockey Now.)

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke (upper body) is expected to play against Buffalo on Saturday, per Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site.
Brandt Clarke.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Zach Dooley (Kings')

Brandt Clarke.summary: Clarke (upper body) won't return to Thursday's game versus the Senators.

Connor Bedard.summary: Bedard scored a power-play goal and added an even-strength assist in Saturday's 5-4 shootout loss to the Jets.
Bedard scored a goal, dished an assist, added two hits and blocked two shots in Saturday's 9-2 loss to the Hurricanes.

Connor Hellebuyck.summary: Hellebuyck turned aside 43 shots in Saturday's 7-4 win over the Capitals.
Hellebuyck will defend the road net against Washington on Saturday.

Pavel Dorofeyev.summary: Dorofeyev tallied the game-winning goal and fired three shots on net in Saturday's 4-3 win over the Kraken.
Dorofeyev scored a power-play goal on four shots in Thursday's 3-2 win over the Flyers.

Mark Stone.summary: Stone scored a power-play goal in Monday's 3-2 shootout loss to the Bruins.
Stone scored a power-play goal, added four hits and went minus-2 in Friday's 5-2 loss to the Devils.

Justin Faulk.summary: Faulk scored a power-play goal and added an even-strength assist in Monday's 5-3 win over the Panthers.
Faulk scored a power-play goal on four shots, added two blocked shots and logged two PIM in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.

Gavin McKenna.summary: McKenna scored a goal on four shots in a 4-2 loss to Montreal on Saturday.
McKenna scored two power-play goals, dished an assist and added two PIM in Wednesday's 5-4 loss to the Kraken.

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson Ek (upper body) will play against Boston on Saturday, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports.
Joel Eriksson Ek.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Michael Russo (The Athletic)

Joel Eriksson Ek.summary: Eriksson Ek sustained an apparent upper-body injury versus the Maple Leafs on Wednesday, and head coach John Hynes had no update on his status after the game, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports.
Joel Eriksson Ek.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Michael Russo (The Athletic)

Mikael Granlund.summary: Granlund scored a goal on four shots and added an assist in Wednesday's 4-2 loss to the Predators.
Granlund scored a power-play goal on three shots, distributed three assists and blocked two shots in Sunday's 5-2 win over the Penguins.

Mackenzie Blackwood.summary: Blackwood stopped 25 of 26 shots in Saturday's 4-1 win over the Canadiens.
Blackwood will guard the road net in Saturday's clash against the Canadiens, per Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports.
Mackenzie Blackwood.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Renaud Lavoie (TVA Sports.)

Simon Edvinsson.summary: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.
Edvinsson, who is a restricted free agent, has returned to Sweden to resume his training, per Andreas III Johnsson of Goteborgs-Posten on Wednesday.
Simon Edvinsson.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Andreas III Johnsson (Goteborgs-Posten)

Charle-Edouard D'Astous.summary: D'Astous scored a goal and added two assists in a 4-3 overtime win over the Wild on Saturday.
D'Astois scored a goal on three shots, dished a power-play assist, added two PIM, levied five hits, blocked three shots in and went plus-2 in Friday's 6-3 loss to the Avalanche.

Jack Quinn.summary: Quinn notches two assists (one on the power play) in Thursday's 3-2 overtime loss to the Blackhawks.
Quinn scored a goal on three shots, added an assist and went plus-3 in Friday's 5-2 win over the Blue Jackets.

Victor Olofsson.summary: Olofsson scored a goal on four shots in Friday's 3-2 shootout loss to the Predators.
Olofsson scored a power-play goal on six shots and added two assists in Wednesday's 5-3 win over the Mammoth.

Ryan Nugent-Hopkins.summary: Nugent-Hopkins (face) will be in the lineup against the Rangers on Monday.
Nugent-Hopkins took a puck to the side of the head in Saturday's game versus the Canucks, Derek Van Diest of NHL.com reports. Per the Sportsnet broadcast, the forward will not finish the game.
Ryan Nugent-Hopkins.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Derek Van Diest (NHL.com)

Tristan Jarry.summary: Jarry stopped 30 of 32 shots in Wednesday's 3-2 overtime win over the Flyers.
Jarry will start Wednesday's home game against the Flyers, Ryan Rishaug of TSN reports.
Tristan Jarry.credit: Rotowire via ESPN, citing Ryan Rishaug (TSN)
